name: ContextSwitcher
description: Choose a context (an organisation, a project, a workspace) from a complete local hierarchy or a bounded server directory.
signature: <I extends ContextItem>({ items, remote, value, onValueChange, recent, open: openProp, onOpenChange, labels: labelsProp, all, icon, className, }: ContextSwitcherProps<I>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: all
props.description:
Offer an "all" row that clears the scope (default true). Without it, null means nothing
is chosen yet and the trigger reads `labels.choose`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph for the "all" scope and for nothing chosen (default the organisation glyph).

props.name: items
props.description: Complete local hierarchy, or the loaded flat server results when remote is supplied.

props.name: labels
props.description:
The words it shows and announces. Default: organisations. Build a set for another noun
with `switcherLabels({ one: "project", other: "projects" })`; single overrides merge
over the default.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state when the popup (or phone sheet) opens or closes, including the close after a choice. Pair with `open` to control it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: A choice was made (also when it is the current one: the caller may ignore it).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state, so a palette command or a shortcut can open it.

props.name: recent
props.description: Recently chosen context ids, most recent first (useRecentContexts).

props.name: remote
props.description: Controlled server search/paging. Bypasses local filtering and ignores parent links and recents.

props.name: value
props.description: The current scope: a context id, or null for all (or none, when `all` is false).
